user_query: What kinds of citation networks did LINE evaluate on, and what does the author citation network record?
llm_response: LINE evaluated on two kinds of citation networks: a paper citation network and an author citation network. The author citation network records citation relationships between authors, typically indicating that one author has cited another through their papers.
llm_confidence_reasoning: This matches the standard description of LINE’s citation-network experiments, though wording can vary slightly across sources.
